subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: The GitHub adapter shall keep the aggregate rate of content-writing requests within the platform's published secondary limits and shall surface saturation to callers as backpressure, never as a platform rate-limit error.
rationale: the write path is the binding budget (§2.4); N workers land together
fit_criterion: a burst fixture replaying nine tasks' write sets concurrently completes with zero platform rate-limit responses; writes are delayed, none dropped
